extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism adjudication from primary XML/PDF figures, methods, and DOC supplement captions; worker-5 automated locator notes were treated as hypotheses only.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: P9 directly binds viral glycoproteins, with primary evidence for influenza HA and supplementary evidence for MERS-CoV S2; this supports virus-particle binding as an entry-stage mechanism.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=8:P9 inhibited influenza virus infection through binding to viral surface glycoproteins; xml:fig=4:Figure 4e-f; supp:local-DRAMP-41598_2016_BFsrep22008_MOESM1_ESM.doc:Supplementary Figure 5

mechanism_claims.limitations: The source supports HA/S2 binding, not a generalized claim of direct binding to every respiratory-virus glycoprotein tested.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: P9 acts when prebound to virus rather than when cells are pretreated, enters cells with virus particles, and blocks viral RNA release/replication after endocytosis.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: P9-pretreated influenza virus in MDCK cells

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=8; xml:sec=9:P9 blocked viral RNA release from late endosomes; xml:fig=4:Figure 4c-d; xml:fig=5:Figure 5

mechanism_claims.limitations: This is an influenza-cell-entry mechanism claim; it should not be reframed as nonspecific membrane permeabilization.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: P9 suppresses endosomal pH lowering, consistent with blocking pH-dependent membrane fusion/uncoating and viral RNA release from late endosomes.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=10:P9 prevented endosomal acidification; xml:fig=6:Figure 6; table=1:P9-aci-1 analog note

mechanism_claims.limitations: The source supports endosomal-acidification interference; it does not support direct M2-channel inhibition.

caution_findings.note: Final mechanism claims are limited to viral glycoprotein binding, virus-bound entry/RNA-release blockade, and endosomal pH effects; broad database comments are not expanded beyond local source support.
